主要内容: Legacy Reserves Inc. has completed its financial restructuring and emerged from chapter 11 bankruptcy. The company reduced its debt through equitization and $255 million in new equity, resulting in total debt of $388 million under a new reserve-based credit facility with an initial borrowing base of $460 million. The facility is led by Wells Fargo Bank, RBC Capital Markets, and other financial institutions. The restructuring also included the appointment of a new Board of Directors with former energy executives. The company focuses on oil and natural gas development in the Permian Basin and cost-efficient management of wells in the Perm, East Texas, Rocky Mountain, and Mid-Continent regions. Legal and financial advisors, including Sidley Austin LLP, Perella Weinberg Partners, and Alvarez & Marsal, were involved in the process. The restructuring aims to stabilize the company's financial position and improve its business prospects.
